description: This file defines a React component 'RichEditor' that provides a rich text editing interface built on the TipTap editor framework. It manages editor initialization, configuration, image handling (upload and paste), content state management, and rendering of a toolbar and editor interface. It also specifies related types and props for external use.

methods.name: RichEditor
methods.description: React component initializing and rendering a TipTap-based rich text editor with image upload/paste support and a toolbar.
methods.handleAddImageByUrl: Prompts user for an image URL and inserts it into the editor.
methods.handleUploadImage: Opens file dialog to upload an image, uploads via onUploadImage callback, and inserts into editor.
methods.useEffect: Initializes the editor instance and updates content based on initialContent prop.
methods.useCallback: Defines functions for image insertion and upload actions.
